spans.s: DG0176 मूल द्रव्य mūla dravya Causative substances that are said to be the cause of manifestation of all other substances; Synonym of Karana Dravya.
AT0217 मूलजानि स्थिराणि च mūlajāni sthirāṇi ca It is a group of poisons of immobile origin in which poison is especially present in its roots.
DG0177 मूलिनि mūlini A group of 16 plants whose roots are used indicated for Paṁchakarma therapy.
